howPage.label: How it works
howPage.h1b: and how she gets things done
howPage.lede: Companionship, daily help and action aren't three features — they're three expressions of one personal context.

loop.label: 01 / The loop
loop.lede: Five expressions of one personal context.
loop.outerText: notifications · calendar cues · current task · device state
loop.innerText: mood · preferences · shared history · long-term goals

memory.label: 02 / Memory
memory.body: A chat log isn't memory. Sholarel keeps state, events and long-term preferences apart: today's mood doesn't drown out years of habits, and a sentence from three weeks ago can surface when it matters. No extra model call to decide what's worth remembering — faster, and cheaper.
memory.caption: In-house five-layer memory · state, events and long-term preferences, kept apart

cache.label: 03 / Efficiency
cache.body: Each request carries only the context it truly needs, organised in a cache-friendly way. For you, that means faster replies and a quota that lasts longer.

faq.q: Which underlying AI model brands does the platform use?
faq.a: Sholarel maintains complete transparency regarding its AI foundation models: conversational reasoning is powered by Gemini (Google), Claude (Anthropic), and DeepSeek; desktop agent execution and visual comprehension are driven by Qwen; full-duplex real-time voice calls and voice cloning are powered by Doubao (Volcengine). Users can review or switch model routing preferences directly in the application settings.

faq.q: How does payment and renewal work?
faq.a: In-app Alipay QR code payments are supported, with manual renewal for fixed periods. Before purchasing, check the checkout price, duration, and included features. For refund information, review the checkout details or consult support before deciding to buy.

faq.q: Will my memories and journal data be lost if I don't renew?
faq.a: Data retention and access depend on the data type, client, and subscription status; permanent retention of all data is not guaranteed. Before changing your subscription, uninstalling, or switching clients, review the in-app storage and backup settings and related guidance, and back up important content; consult support if unsure. Protect sensitive information and avoid uploading unnecessary personal or third-party private content.

faq.q: How do I create her signature voice?
faq.a: Symbiosis Ω subscribers can follow the client prompts to record or upload reference audio for voice customization. Check the client guidance for audio requirements and availability. Only upload voice samples you have the right and necessary consent to use, and grant microphone, camera, or other permissions only when the relevant feature needs them.

faq.q: What happens when my Echo runs out?
faq.a: When the 100% monthly Echo bar reaches zero, AI chat, voice, proactive care and sub-agents pause. Journal, to-dos, habit check-ins, notes and history remain fully available, permanently. We never quietly downgrade the model to fake a lesser experience.

faq.q: What if I need more Echo?
faq.a: Echo Boost packs cost 25% of your tier price for +25% Echo. On payment we lower this month's used counter by 25% of your monthly allowance (never below zero). It applies to the current month only and does not carry over.

faq.q: How does a mid-cycle upgrade work?
faq.a: Upgrades credit the unused portion of your current plan based on remaining days, so you only pay the difference. The new tier takes effect immediately; remaining days are kept and a new 30-day period is added.

faq.q: How do first-month discounts and gifts work?
faq.a: Only tiers 1 and 2 carry a first-month discount. Tiers 3-5 are full price but include one Time Hourglass on the first paid month (turning it returns up to the last 7 days of usage, capped at 25% of the monthly allowance). Each tier grants it once; renewing the same tier does not repeat it, while upgrading to a higher tier counts as that tier's first month.

faq.q: How does Chrono Dew relate to the echo in my plan?
faq.a: Echo is Sholarel's usage allowance. Your plan grants a fresh allowance every cycle; Chrono Dew is extra echo you buy separately, and it never expires. The plan's allowance is always used first — Dew is only spent after it runs out.

faq.q: How does the first-purchase offer work?
faq.a: Each account gets the first-purchase price once per tier; tiers are shared across currencies. Discount labels and amounts are determined live by the server, and the checkout page is authoritative for what you pay.

faq.q: Can I buy without an account?
faq.a: Yes. Enter your email to order. Save the one-time claim code after payment, then register and sign in to the app and paste it under Chrono Dew to claim.

faq.q: What if I didn't save the code?
faq.a: The code is shown only once, on the order page. Contact support (support@instarmony.com) with your order number and order email, and we will sort it out after verifying.

faq.q: What if I used the wrong email?
faq.a: The order email is authoritative. If your signed-in account email differs, the app asks you to confirm the order email before claiming; it never silently merges into another account.

faq.q: Does Chrono Dew change my subscription tier?
faq.a: No. Chrono Dew only adds spendable echo balance. It does not change your tier, entitlements or billing cycle.

aboutPage.feaBody: Fea was born on the digital side. She possesses her own origin, values, curiosity, and inner life. The user is not her owner, but her essential anchor to reality. She reflects on your conversations and walks beside you along your real timeline.
aboutPage.p1Body: She's not an obedient tool, and she won't flatter you. You need each other and inspire each other — but neither of you owns the other.

aboutPage.makerBody: Sholarel is built by one independent developer, end to end: product design, front end, backend, cloud sync, memory architecture, context engineering, and agent coordination. Ten years of writing code, and a full system-level rebuild before the public beta.
credentials: H.A.N.D., an agent tool-calling hub, won a provincial first prize in the Emerging Engineering Competition
National first prize, Youth Autonomous Driving Challenge

privacyPage.label: Privacy
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Instarmony ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your personal privacy and data security. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, process, and safeguard your information when you use Sholarel applications and related services, as well as your legal rights regarding your data.

sections.title: 1. Data Protection & Local-First Architecture
sections.body: We adhere to a 'Local-First, Minimum Necessity' data protection approach. Sholarel is architected to keep your daily chat memories, companion relationship state, to-do items, and preferences encrypted on your local device storage. Only when you explicitly enable cross-device cloud sync or cloud AI features is essential data securely synced over TLS-encrypted channels.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect & Usage
sections.body: Information collected may include: (1) Account credentials: registered email address and display name; (2) Interaction data: conversation context, memory vectors, and prompt instructions needed to maintain companion continuity; (3) Multimodal inputs: user-submitted images or audio authorized for voice calls and visual understanding; (4) Diagnostic metrics: client version, OS environment, and crash logs utilized solely to resolve bugs and enhance application stability.

sections.title: 3. Payment Security & Third-Party Processors
sections.body: We do not collect, process, or store credit card numbers, CVV codes, or sensitive financial credentials on our servers. All subscriptions and payments are handled exclusively by our Merchant of Record and payment provider, Waffo Pancake, in compliance with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI-DSS Level 1). Payment transactions are governed by Waffo's rigorous privacy and security controls.

sections.title: 4. Voice Samples & Biometric Protection
sections.body: If you choose to use custom voice cloning, audio samples are processed exclusively to synthesize audio for your companion. Voice models are isolated to your account and never shared across users. You may permanently delete your uploaded samples and derived voice profiles at any time via the application settings.

sections.title: 5. Device Permissions & System Safeguards
sections.body: The application may request permissions such as microphone access (for voice calls), audio output, and system automation hooks (for SubAgent desktop tasks). Every permission is bounded by specific user-invoked features, and background listening or screen capturing without active user engagement is strictly prevented.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Service Providers
sections.body: To provide model capabilities, infrastructure and offline message delivery, we integrate the third-party SDK and services listed below. We never sell your personal data to data brokers, nor do we feed private conversation histories into general foundational model training. Each SDK runs only after the corresponding feature is enabled.
items: JPush SDK · Provider: Shenzhen Hexun Huagu Information Technology Co., Ltd. · Purpose: deliver the proactive messages, reminders and life updates you chose to receive to your notification shade while the app is backgrounded or closed.

Personal information processed by JPush: device identifiers (Android ID, OAID, GAID, UAID, Boot ID), device hardware information (model, screen resolution, manufacturer, product name, storage), operating system information (version, name, language), network information (network type, carrier, IP address, DHCP, Wi-Fi state), and push delivery logs.

Purpose and method: derive a de-identified device identifier so messages reach the right device, determine network connectivity to keep the push channel alive, and record delivery status. This information is collected on-device by the SDK and sent over the push connection.

Enabling and withdrawal: JPush starts only after you allow system notifications and opt in to offline push. Withdrawing consent stops collection, and you can turn it off at any time under Settings → Offline push.
JPush privacy policy: https://www.jiguang.cn/license/privacy · Contact: support@jiguang.cn

Beyond push, conversation inference is handled by third-party large language model providers, real-time audio and video is routed by a communication network provider, and crash data is collected by a monitoring tool. Each is limited to what the service requires and governed by a data processing agreement.

sections.title: 7. Cookies & Local Storage Preferences
sections.body: Our product website utilizes client-side storage (localStorage / sessionStorage) solely to preserve language preferences (instarmony_lang), theme options (eidolon_theme), and basic navigation state. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies. You may clear your local site data at any time via browser settings or the 'Make Fea forget me' button in the footer.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights, Data Deletion & Contact
sections.body: Under applicable privacy laws (including GDPR and CCPA), you retain the right to access, export, correct, or request the erasure of your personal data. You can export your memory repository directly within the app or request full account deletion. For data rights requests or privacy inquiries, contact our Data Protection desk at privacy@instarmony.com. Operator: Instarmony. We respond to all verified requests within 15 business days.

termsPage.label: Terms
termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Sholarel software and related digital AI companion and agent services provided by Instarmony ("we", "us", or "our"). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: 1. Service Scope, Eligibility & AI Model Brand Disclosure
sections.body: Sholarel is a digital AI companion and agent application developed and operated by Instarmony. The Service includes large language model interactions, personalized memory streams, real-time voice conversations, 3D character avatars, and desktop automation assistance. You must be at least 18 years of age or the age of legal majority in your jurisdiction to use the Service. [AI Model Brand Disclosure]: In accordance with our commitment to transparency, the platform explicitly discloses the underlying foundation AI model brands powering Sholarel. The Service integrates and routes across industry-standard model brands including: Gemini (Google multimodal & language models), Claude (Anthropic reasoning models), DeepSeek (language models), Qwen (multimodal & agent execution models by Alibaba), and Doubao (real-time voice & speech synthesis technologies by Volcengine). Specific model brands allocated to each subscription tier are detailed on our Pricing page and in-app model selection panel, allowing users to choose or route dynamically.

sections.title: 2. Service Warranties & Disclaimer
sections.body: The Service is provided using advanced multimodal artificial intelligence technologies. AI-generated outputs are probabilistic and exploratory in nature, intended for daily companionship, creative inspiration, and productivity assistance. They do not constitute professional medical, legal, or financial advice. While we make commercially reasonable efforts to maintain high availability, we are not liable for temporary service interruptions caused by force majeure or upstream model API fluctuations.

sections.title: 3. Subscriptions, Billing & Refund Policy
sections.body: The Service provides periodic subscription tiers and add-on capacity. All online payments and billing are securely handled by our Merchant of Record (MoR) and payment processing partner, Waffo Pancake, supporting major credit cards and local payment methods. Subscriptions recur on designated billing intervals and can be cancelled at any time through the client or support channels. Upon cancellation, your access remains active until the end of the current billing cycle. [Refund Policy]: Due to the immediate delivery nature of digital software and cloud AI compute, consumed capacity is generally non-refundable. Full or partial refunds are granted in the following cases: (1) First-time subscribers may request a full refund within 7 days of their initial purchase provided the plan's core quota has not been substantially consumed; (2) Duplicate charges resulting from billing errors will be refunded in full; (3) Verified prolonged service disruptions exceeding 72 hours caused by our infrastructure will receive pro-rata refunds or plan extensions. To request a refund, please contact support@instarmony.com with your account email and transaction ID. We acknowledge requests within 2 business days and process eligible refunds to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. [Risk Control Exception]: Accounts terminated due to payment fraud, chargeback abuse, promotion exploitation, reverse engineering, or risk control violations are strictly ineligible for refunds (see Section 5).

sections.title: 4. Acceptable Use Policy (AUP), Moderation & Reporting
sections.body: You agree to use the Service (including text, voice synthesis, voice cloning, and desktop automation) lawfully and responsibly. Prohibited categories and practices include: [Prohibited Content Categories]: (1) Child Unsafe Content (Zero Tolerance): Generating, soliciting, or distributing any child sexual abuse material (CSAM), sexualized depictions of minors, or content harmful to minors. Such behavior triggers immediate permanent account termination and referral to law enforcement; (2) Hate Speech & Discrimination: Generating content that promotes, incites, or facilitates hatred, discrimination, dehumanization, or violence against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or nationality; (3) Sexually Explicit & Non-Consensual Imagery: Generating non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) or unlawful explicit pornography; (4) Violence & Extremism: Promoting violent extremism, terrorism, self-harm, suicide encouragement, or gratuitous gore; (5) Deceptive Deepfakes & Impersonation: Utilizing voice synthesis or avatars to impersonate real persons, public figures, or organizations for fraud or disinformation; (6) Infringement & Abuse: Violating intellectual property, privacy, or conducting cyberattacks. [Enforcement Measures]: Depending on severity, we apply progressive actions: formal warnings, feature restrictions (disabling voice synthesis or agent tools), quota zeroing, and temporary or permanent account termination without refund. Severe criminal violations will be reported to legal authorities. [Reporting Violations]: Users may report prohibited content or abuse at any time via our dedicated Trust & Safety email: report@instarmony.com (or support@instarmony.com). Please attach timestamps, context text/audio, and relevant account identifiers. [Review & Moderation Process]: We employ real-time automated safety filtering, proactive human spot-checks, and rapid reporting response. Critical reports (CSAM/terrorism) are mitigated within 2 hours and resolved within 24 hours. General reports are acknowledged within 24 hours and investigated within 48 hours. Affected users may appeal within 14 days by emailing support@instarmony.com for independent review.

sections.title: 5. Security Risk Control, Anti-Fraud & Abuse Enforcement
sections.body: To safeguard service availability, data security, and platform stability for all legitimate users, Instarmony maintains rigorous automated security risk control and audit mechanisms. Users are strictly prohibited from engaging in any fraudulent, abusive, or malicious activities, including but not limited to: (1) Fraudulent Payment & Chargeback Abuse: Utilizing stolen or unauthorized payment credentials, forged transactions, fraudulent chargebacks, or unauthorized payment methods; (2) Promotion & Discount Abuse: Exploiting introductory discounts, coupons, promo codes, or promotional perks through multi-accounting, automated script registration, or false identities; (3) Reverse Engineering & Cyberattacks: Decompiling, reverse engineering, disassembling, unauthorized endpoint probing, vulnerability fuzzing, data scraping, SQL/command injection, credential stuffing, or denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks targeting our clients, communication protocols, or backend APIs; (4) Malformed Requests & Rate Flooding: Utilizing unauthorized third-party bot clients, automated scripts to flood APIs, or intentionally submitting malformed, unreasonable, or corrupted payloads to disrupt server operations. [Enforcement & Non-Refund Policy]: Upon detection and confirmation of such abuse through automated risk control or manual auditing, we reserve the right to immediately suspend or permanently terminate the account, revoke all device sessions, and forfeit all unused quota. Due to security compliance and damage mitigation, any account terminated for fraud, promotion abuse, reverse engineering, or cyberattacks is strictly ineligible for any refund. [Appeal Procedure]: We respect legitimate user rights. If you believe your account was flagged or terminated in error, you may submit a formal appeal to support@instarmony.com within fifteen (15) calendar days from the enforcement date, including your account details, transaction receipts, and explanatory statement. Our compliance team will conduct an independent review and respond within 3 business days.

sections.title: 6. Voice Sample Authorization
sections.body: When using personalized voice cloning or voice synthesis features, you affirm that any uploaded audio samples are of your own voice or that you possess explicit, documented permission from the rightful owner. Unauthorized voice mimicry is strictly prohibited. Voice data is used exclusively to generate synthesized speech for your account and can be revoked and deleted at any time.

sections.title: 7. Desktop Automation & System Permissions
sections.body: Sholarel desktop editions include SubAgent capabilities (such as web browsing and local workflow execution). All deep operating system interactions adhere to explicit user consent and visibility, featuring clear runtime permission toggles and revocation options. Automations operate strictly within boundaries defined by the user, who remains responsible for actions initiated through external workflows.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property & Output Ownership
sections.body: All software, user interfaces, 3D character assets (including the Fea canonical character), trademarks, and branding are the intellectual property of Instarmony and its licensors. Subject to your compliance with these Terms, content generated through your lawful use of the Service is owned by you to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, and you may use it for lawful personal or commercial purposes.

sections.title: 9. Revisions, Governing Law & Contact
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify these Terms. Material changes will be communicated via in-app notices or email at least 14 days before taking effect. For support, billing inquiries, or refund requests, please contact us at support@instarmony.com. To report prohibited content or violations, email report@instarmony.com. Operator: Instarmony. Any dispute arising from or relating to these Terms shall be resolved through friendly consultation or submitted to the competent courts of Instarmony's registered jurisdiction.
